_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <workCalendarId>-E<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

workCalendarId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_workCalendar._id: the parent document this one belongs to

workCalendarName.description: Display value of workCalendarId, copied from u_mes_mast_workCalendar.name

sequenceNo.description: Position of this document in its list (within the same parent for child collections), starting at 1

exceptionDate.description: Exception date (calendar date, stored as the start of that day in IST converted to UTC)

description.description: Description of the work calendar exception

isWorking.description: True when the record is working

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
